verdict.rationale: Superpowers documents multiple one-line install paths per harness (e.g. `/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace` + `/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`, git-clone for Hermes) and claims skills auto-trigger at session start via SessionStart hooks/context injection, which a runtime probe partially corroborates (an `npx skills add` install worked end-to-end and the skill file loaded correctly). However, install is harness-specific ("install Superpowers separately for each one") rather than a single universal command, and community commentary calls the codex/opencode install mechanism unusual ("like curl|bash but with added LLM agents"), indicating some install friction. Missing for 10: independent confirmation that a single documented command works identically and activates immediately across all supported harnesses, and no community report explicitly confirming next-session activation outside vendor docs.
